editorial_note: Scheduled cloud handoff-only run for 2026-09-30 (Wednesday). No breaking real-estate or lifestyle story cleared the full primary + two-independent-origin + currency + image bar by the end of discovery, so a verified data-analysis article built entirely from the City of Columbus Building Permits open dataset (CC0 1.0) was produced instead. The article, 'Columbus Permitted Fewer New Homes in the Third Quarter of 2026,' closes the third quarter (which ends today) with a citywide new-housing-permit review: 1,599 new residential units in Q3, down about 11 percent from Q3 2025 and below Q2 2026, front-loaded in July and concentrated in four ZIP codes. It is distinct from the 2026-09-29 weekly Permit Pulse (single-week view) and the 2026-09-27 monthly Demolition Watch. This receipt records the editorial outcome only; it is never publication authority. No import, image preparation, email delivery, or publication is claimed, and no git commit is treated as publication or downstream-import success.

story_facts_verified.source: City of Columbus Building Permits open dataset (CC0 1.0), Open Data hub item f7a785b863454d96a0fe3f5aa5368e7d, pulled 2026-09-30 via the ArcGIS feature service; residential = GENERAL_TYPE 'Multi Family - New Structure' plus '1,2,3 Family - New Structure'.
story_facts_verified.monthly_2026_residential_units: Jan 274, Feb 47, Mar 674, Apr 1,425, May 369, Jun 243, Jul 1,011, Aug 362, Sep 226. July = 1,011 / 1,599 = about 63 percent of Q3.
story_facts_verified.q3_top_zips: 43219 387, 43207 374, 43212 263, 43081 252 (sum 1,276 = about 80 percent of 1,599); 22 distinct ZIP codes total.
story_facts_verified.largest_q3_projects: Single 263-unit multifamily permit at 1515 Gerrard Ave (43212, issued 2026-07-23); cluster of 24-unit permits on Sovereign Crest Dr / Prestige Pointe Ave / Regency Grove Ln / Brighton Reserve Way (43219, 2026-07-28); South Side clusters on W Castle Rd, Stone Case Rd, Feather Edge Ln (43207); Brady Alexander Ct and Presley Hope Pl (43081).
story_facts_verified.cross_check: Quarterly type sums reconcile to the 2026-09-29 Permit Pulse year-to-date figures: MF 857+1,750+1,361 = 3,968; one-to-three-family 138+287+238 = 663; commercial 4+482+26 = 512.
story_facts_verified.original_contributions: Quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year comparison; nine-month pace comparison; intra-quarter monthly breakdown isolating July's front-loading; ZIP-level geographic concentration and identification of the specific large multifamily filings driving each top ZIP.
story_facts_verified.limitations_stated: Permits are not completed homes; one project can carry a separate structural permit per building; declared values are often blank and are not sale prices; the feed updates daily and late entries can lift September and the Q3 total after the pull.
